policy: Explicit exceptions apply only when that variant leaves the key unset. High-contrast state borders are always mapped. No wildcard exceptions.

accepted.agentsMobileDiff.addedForeground: Mobile-only registration is absent from the desktop 1.136.1 schema; retain that separate client's native color.
accepted.agentsMobileDiff.deletedForeground: Mobile-only registration is absent from the desktop 1.136.1 schema; retain that separate client's native color.
accepted.agentsMobileDiff.modifiedForeground: Mobile-only registration is absent from the desktop 1.136.1 schema; retain that separate client's native color.
accepted.agentsNewSessionButton.background: Retain the native transparent background; this button inherits its containing surface.
accepted.diffEditor.unchangedRegionShadow: Retain the neutral decorative shadow separating collapsed unchanged regions.
accepted.editorActiveLineNumber.foreground: Legacy deprecated registration; editorLineNumber.activeForeground is explicitly mapped instead.
accepted.contrastBorder: Night and Day omit universal high-contrast outlines; Contrast explicitly maps this key.
accepted.editor.compositionBorder: Keep the native IME composition treatment in Night/Day; Contrast maps the visible border.
accepted.editor.lineHighlightBorder: Night/Day use the subtle filled current line; Contrast explicitly maps a state border.
accepted.editor.selectionForeground: Night/Day retain syntax foregrounds in selections; Contrast explicitly sets this key.
accepted.editor.snippetFinalTabstopHighlightBorde: Retain the normal-theme null border for snippet final stops; Contrast maps the border.
accepted.editorError.border: Night/Day retain the normal null extra border and use the error squiggle; Contrast maps its border.
accepted.editorWarning.border: Night/Day retain the normal null extra border and use the warning squiggle; Contrast maps its border.
accepted.editorInfo.border: Night/Day retain the normal null extra border and use the information squiggle; Contrast maps its border.
accepted.editorHint.border: Night/Day retain the normal null extra border; Contrast uses a palette hint border.
accepted.editorGhostText.border: Night/Day intentionally have no inline-suggestion box; Contrast explicitly maps its border.
accepted.editorOverviewRuler.border: Retain the normal-theme null ruler border; Contrast explicitly maps the border.
accepted.editorUnnecessaryCode.border: Night/Day fade unused code without an underline; Contrast explicitly uses the dashed border.
accepted.listFilterWidget.outline: Night/Day retain the normal transparent outline; Contrast explicitly maps the outline.
accepted.panelInput.border: Normal themes inherit the input border; Contrast explicitly maps this border.
accepted.simpleFindWidget.sashBorder: Normal themes retain a transparent divider; Contrast explicitly maps the divider.
accepted.terminal.selectionForeground: Night/Day preserve ANSI foregrounds during selection; Contrast explicitly supplies readable text.
accepted.terminalStickyScroll.border: Normal themes retain the native null border; Contrast explicitly maps the border.
accepted.welcomePage.tileBorder: Normal themes retain the default null tile border; Contrast explicitly maps it.
